note: 时代和环境变化非常快速，因此我们必须持续将目光聚焦在未来。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: He that is over-cautious will accomplish little.
note: 过分谨慎的人难有成就。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Success is walking from failure to failure with no loss of enthusiasm.
note: 成功就是经历一次次失败，却都不失热情。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: He is no wise man who will quit a certainty for an uncertainty.
note: 为了不确定的事而放弃确定的事是不智的。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: We reform others unconsciously when we walk uprightly.
note: 当我们行为端正，我们无意中转化他人。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Big shots are only little shots who keep shooting.
note: 大人物都是从小人物时不断地尝试而造就。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Become the person who would attract the results you seek.
note: 努力成为那位能获得你追寻目标的人物。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: You’ll never get ahead by blaming your problems on other people.
note: 怪罪别人绝不会让你获得成功。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: You're not obligated to win. You're obligated to keep trying. To the best you can do everyday.
note: 但你必须不断尝试，每天表现你最好的一面。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Don’t worry about failure; you only have to be right once.
note: 别害怕失败，只要做对一次就够了。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: If you want something you've never had, you must be willing to do something you've never done.
note: 若想得到你从未拥有的东西，你得愿意做你从未做过的事。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
note: 你得先跨越恐惧才能获得你所想要的一切。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Being alone in a strange place as a visitor, more so I miss my dear ones on festivals.
note: 独在异乡为异客，每逢佳节倍思亲。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: If you don't make things happen, then things will happen to you.
note: 你不造就未来，就不能控制发生在你身上的事。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Doubt is a killer. You just have to know who you are and what you stand for.
note: 怀疑心是杀手。 你需要做的仅是知道自己的立场和自己是为谁而战。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Use the losses and failures of the past as a reason for action, not inaction.
note: 过去的损失和失败经验，应是你采取行动，而非不采取行动的理由。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Idealism increases in direct proportion to one’s distance from the problem.
note: 一个人离问题愈远就愈理想主义。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Motivation will almost always beat mere talent.
note: 动机总是能战胜天赋。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Change before you have to.
note: 在被迫改变之前自己先改变
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Once you surrender to your vision, success begins to chase you.
note: 当你把自已交给愿景后，成功开始追逐你。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: You can't give up! If you give up, you're like everybody else.
note: 不要放弃！ 一旦你放弃了，就跟一般人没什么两样了。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Never walk away from failure. On the contrary, study it carefully and imaginatively for its hidden assets.
note: 遇到失败绝不要一走了之，相反的，为其隐藏的资产仔细并有想像力的研究。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: There’s never any guarantee that anyone will like you. So if anyone likes you at all, you’ve already won.
note: 永远无法保证有人会喜欢你。 所以如果有人喜欢你，你就已经赢了。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: If you’re offered a seat on a rocket ship, don’t ask what seat! Just get on.
note: 如果有人想提供一个绝佳的成长机会给你，千万别再问对方有哪些机会选择，先把握住就对了。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Eloquent speech is not from lip to ear, but rather from heart to heart.
note: 再有说服力的演讲，讯息的传递不是由口到耳，而是由心到心。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: The harder you work, the luckier you get.
note: 越努力就能越幸运。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: If you're going through hell, keep going.
note: 如果你正在经历困境苦难的途中，请继续前进。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Cherish forever what makes you unique, cuz you’re really a yawn if it goes.
note: 感恩能让你与众不同的一切，因为失去这些差异你将会过的索然无味。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Nothing is impossible; the word itself says 'I'm possible!
note: 没有什么是不可能的 ; 这个词本意就是“我有一切可能” 。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Whatever you are, be a good one.
note: 无论你是谁，请当好的那一位。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: The road to Easy Street goes through the sewer.
note: 前往「康庄大道」的路途中，你得先经历过下水道。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Life is short, and it’s up to you to make it sweet.
note: 生命短暂，而你可以决定让它活出灿烂。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Either run the day or the day runs you.
note: 成功的人主宰时间，失败的人被时间主宰。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: There’s so much creativity in brokeness. Brokeness will have you making it work.
note: 跳脱常规激发更多的创造力，同时可以造就不凡的成功。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: If they don’t give you a seat at the table, bring a folding chair
note: 即使没人给你上桌的机会，你依旧得想尽办法让自己参与其中。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: I attribute my success to this: I never gave or took any excuse.
note: 我将成功归功于这一点：从不给或找任何借口。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.
note: 你人生的高度取决于你的态度非你的能力。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Quality performance starts with a positive attitude.
note: 优质的表现始于积极的态度。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: A life lived by choice is a life of conscious action. A life lived by chance is a life of unconscious reaction.
note: 选择生活的人是有意识地行动的人。凭运气生活的人是无意识地反应的人。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.
note: 生命是走向凋零还是兴盛与一个人的勇气成正比。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: A man, as a general rule, owes very little to what he is born with – a man is what he makes of himself.
note: 人一般而言，天生的能力对他影响不大， 他如何造就自己决定他的人生。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Knowing is not enough; we must apply.
note: 光是知道是不够的; 我们必须能够应用。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Wishing is not enough; we must do.
note: 光是许愿望是不够的; 我们必须行动。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: All great achievements require time.
note: 所有伟大的成就都需要时间的积累。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: I have stood on a mountain of no’s for one yes.
note: 我在所有反对声中抵达山顶，只为获得一个肯定。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: You will face many defeats in life, but never let yourself be defeated.
note: 人的一生都会面临许多磨难，但永远别让自己被磨难打败。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Knowing what must be done does away with fear.
note: 当清楚知道目标该做什么时，恐惧感就会自行远离。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: If you want to make money, you have to help someone else make money.
note: 如果你想赚到钱，你必须也能帮别人赚到钱。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: If you don’t risk anything, you risk even more.
note: 如果你不敢冒任何风险，那么你就会身处在更大的风险之中。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Intelligence without ambition is a bird without wings.
note: 聪明但没有抱负，就像没有翅膀的鸟。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
note: 没有人能在取得你的同意前让你自己感到自卑。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: When you undervalue what you do, the world will undervalue who you are.
note: 当你低估自己所做的事情时，世界同时也会低估你的价值。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: The man who has made up his mind to win will never say "impossible".
note: 决心取得胜利的人从来不说“不可能”。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: If you want to lift yourself up, lift up someone else.
note: 如果你想振奋自己， 先振奋周遭的人。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: You just can't beat the person who never gives up.
note: 你无法打败那位永不放弃的人。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Develop your imagination – you can use it to create in your mind what you hope to create in your life.
note: 发展你的想象力 – 你可以用它在心里创造你想在现实生活创造的东西。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: One always has enough time, if one will apply it well.
note: 人总是有足够的时间，如果他好好利用。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Leadership belongs to those who take it.
note: 领导权属于那些想获取它的人。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Beware of monotony; it's the mother of all deadly sins.
note: 当心一成不变; 它是万恶之母。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: I'd rather regret the things I've done than regret the things I haven't done.
note: 我宁可后悔我曾做过的事，也不要懊悔我从未去做。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Learn from the mistakes of others. You can't live long enough to make them yourself.
note: 试着从别人的错误当中学习，因为你没办法用自己的生命实际感受过每一个错误。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: If your actions inspire others to dream more, learn more, do more and become more, you are a leader.
note: 如果你的行为鼓舞别人梦想更多、学习更多、行动更多及改变更多，你即是位领导者。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Growth and comfort do not coexist.
note: 成长与舒适是不并存的。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: If you are not doing what you love, you are wasting your time.
note: 若非在做你喜爱的事，你就是在浪费时间。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Alone we can do so little; together we can do so much.
note: 团结合作胜过于单打独斗。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Life is not always a matter of holding good cards, but sometimes, playing a poor hand well.
note: 人生不只是握有一副好牌，有时候也要把一副坏牌打好。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: If I have seen further, it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.
note: 如果我能看得更远，是因为站在巨人的肩膀上。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: No one can whistle a symphony. It takes a whole orchestra to play it.
note: 没人能独自吹哨出一首交响乐，需要整个乐队一起才能完成演奏。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Coming together is a beginning, staying together is progress, and working together is success.
note: 同流是开端，持续相伴是进展，共同奋斗才是成功。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Talent wins games, but teamwork and intelligence win championships.
note: 天赋可以赢得游戏，但团队合作及智慧可以赢得冠军。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: It is literally true that you can succeed best and quickest by helping others to succeed.
note: 帮助他人成功是让自己最快获得成功的不二法门。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Love starts when we push aside our ego and make room for someone else.
note: 爱始于把自我推到一旁，留些空间给别人。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: At the courier station of Handan on Winter Solstice night, my arms clasping my knees, only my shadow is accompanying me.
note: 邯郸驿里逢冬至，抱膝灯前影伴身。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Individually, we are one drop. Together, we are an ocean.
note: 单独来看， 我们都像是水滴。 当凝聚在一起， 我们就是一片海洋。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Christmas Eve blessing, for you around.
note: 平安夜的祝福，为你围绕。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: May the Christmas candle bring you peace and happiness.
note: 愿圣诞之夜的烛光，带给你温馨和芬芳。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
note: 一个人可以走很快，一群人可以走很远。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Success is best when it's shared.
note: 能一起分享成功的喜悦才是最美好的时刻。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: It is not in the still calm of life, or in the repose of a pacific station, that great characters are formed.
note: 伟大的人格特质，不是在平静的生活，或无风的太平洋港里形成。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: What I’ve really learned over time is that optimism is a very, very important part of leadership.
note: 我在过去真正学到的是，乐观是领导非常、非常重要的一环。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: The loving person makes other people feel good, and he is usually a happy person himself.
note: 有爱心的人让人感到舒服，而他自己通常也是个快乐的人。
caption: 词霸每日一句

content: Satisfaction lies in the effort, not in the attainment.
note: 满足感的源头在于不断努力，而不是现有的成就。
caption: 词霸每日一句
